We have seen the devastating effects of disastrous and irresponsible leadership since Joe Biden took over throughout all levels of our government and institutions.

While the radical left in Congress is playing into petty partisan politics, Republicans are fighting for you, the people.

Wendy is focused on securing the border so our citizens are safe from terrorists, lethal drugs, and the gang-related violence that has spilled into our neighborhoods.

Wendy Davis will bring YOUR conservative values to Congress and help bolster the ranks of our SLIM House Majority. **Since regaining control of the House, Republicans have LOST SEATS.**We NEED A RED WAVE!****

Friends -
When someone tells you who they are and what they want to do, believe them.
Last night, at his Fox News town hall event, Donald Trump took credit for the Supreme Court overturning Roe vs. Wade. He said **"For 54 years, they were trying to get Roe v. Wade terminated, and I did it. And I’m proud to have done it."** And if he’s elected again, he will not stop from going after any and all forms of abortion, in every state of the country. But at least he’s clear about his position and what he plans to do.
In contrast, Republican candidates in swing states are trying to hide who they are and what they plan to do on abortion now that they’ve seen the backlash.
Like a wolf in sheep’s clothing, they know abortion bans are unpopular, especially with women, and they’re hiding their real views and plans to try and win an election.
But make no mistake: if they take the White House and the Senate, they will strip off that sheep’s suit as fast as they can to vote on banning abortion from every angle at the federal level.
And my potential GOP opponents in this Senate race will be happy to help. Every single one of them has either voted for, or is campaigning an extreme anti-abortion agenda that is completely out-of-touch with where Michigan voters are on the issue. A few of them are smart enough to don the sheep’s clothing and try and hide what they have always fought for in previous races.
**With the White House and control of the Senate running through Michigan, it's up to us to call BS on this charade.**

body:
Trump will never understand service because he has only ever served himself.
#
Derek, did you see Trump’s first ad of the 2024 cycle?
His campaign is trying to show that there is no greater supporter of our Troops and Veterans than Trump.
Yeah. Ok.
The guy who **just this weekend** attacked John McCain for not being able to raise his arms after being tortured in the Hanoi Hilton for years.
The guy who shut down our government and put pay for the Troops at risk. Who attacked our Generals and Admirals, and threatened to have the former Chairman of the Joint Chiefs executed.
The guy who called fallen heroes “suckers” and “losers,” who tried to avoid being seen with injured warriors because it “doesn’t look good for me.”
Yeah, that guy.
His campaign can say whatever they want. But the truth is, Trump can’t help himself. Trump looks down on the Military, he looks down on our Veterans. Trump will never understand service because he has only ever served himself.
And it’s our job to make sure that Veterans and members of the Military don’t get the wool pulled over their eyes by this traitor.
That’s why we just rolled out our newest ad, “Buddy Up.”

body:
Clarence Thomas needs to recuse himself.
#
Ginni Thomas, wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, was directly involved with efforts to overturn the 2020 election results.
She sat on the board of the group that planned the ‘Stop the Steal’ rally — which ended in the January 6 insurrection at the Capitol. She also texted Trump’s Chief of Staff directly 29 different times, urging Trump not to concede.
**Now her husband will decide whether the state of Colorado can remove Trump from the ballot for engaging in the insurrection his wife _directly_ supported.**
[We have to stand against this blatant conflict of interest. Will you donate $5 to support AOC’s efforts to get Justice Thomas to recuse himself from the case?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240111.6J5TZf&refcode=em20240111-5625-P_FND_MMF_HDL&t=1&akid=5625%2E2526796%2EmJmYk6)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240111.6J5TZf&refcode=em20240111-5625-P_FND_MMF_HDL&t=2&akid=5625%2E2526796%2EmJmYk6)**
Alexandria joined a letter led by Rep. Hank Johnson and Rep. Dan Goldmanasking Justice Thomas to recuse himself. Thomas has recused himself from cases before and he needs to do it again. **Because a court that rejects accountability for itself erodes its own ability to hold others accountable.**
Colorado’s highest court barred Trump from the GOP primary ballot under Section 3 of the 14th Amendment to the Constitution, which disqualifies citizens that engage in rebellion or insurrection from holding public office. 19 other states have filed challenges to have him removed from the ballot under the same provision. Last week, SCOTUS agreed to hear Trump's appeal to the Colorado decision.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today so that Alexandria can continue to fight for our democracy and finally get accountability for January 6?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240111.6J5TZf&refcode=em20240111-5625-P_FND_MMF_HDL&t=3&akid=5625%2E2526796%2EmJmYk6)
SCOTUS is devolving into a politicized entity known for rank corruption, erosion of democracy, and the unraveling of human rights. We will keep you informed as more on the Supreme Court and the Colorado decision develops.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Contact: Duane Dichiara

| **Mayor Michael Clauzel of Patterson Endorses John Duarte for Congress**** **
---
| | **Modesto **— Today, Patterson Mayor Michael Clauzel endorsed John Duarte's campaign for Congress. Mayor Clauzel is a United States Air Force veteran, sheriff's deputy, and former businessman elected as Patterson's Mayor in 2022.

"I proudly endorse John's reelection campaign," said Mayor Clauzel. "John understands that to improve the future of Valley families, it starts with public safety, economic opportunity, and affordability. John is working hard in Washington to help working families keep more of their pay and to support the law enforcement that keeps us safe."

John Duarte expressed his appreciation, saying, "Mayor Clauzel's endorsement is a testament to our shared commitment to serving the families of Patterson. Together, we will work tirelessly to address the unique needs of Patterson residents."

Congressman Duarte and Mayor Clauzel have a shared mission to prioritize public safety in the Central Valley, ensuring residents have safe places to live, work, raise a family, and run a business. Mayor Clauzel joins a growing list of elected officials, mayors, and public safety leaders endorsing Duarte's candidacy. For more information about John Duarte or the campaign, please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=7638c19a90&e=76a47b375f). ###

body:
Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38934%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nQBS%2bzsKjeg0kEn7SKmmnA&sysid=1)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38945%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mY3nof5%2fe0yR5OWwmoLs3A&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38934%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nQBS%2bzsKjeg0kEn7SKmmnA&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38934%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nQBS%2bzsKjeg0kEn7SKmmnA&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38934%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nQBS%2bzsKjeg0kEn7SKmmnA&sysid=1)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FIFTH** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us keep momentum STRONG!>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/support-nikki-now-underdog-tv?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20240111_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1433367-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-YAN2.103100&utm_content=20240111_i-want-to-share-this-with-you&ex_tid=20240111_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1433367-2667&utm_content=tv-yan-20240112&xunv=tv-yan-20240112 "It would mean a lot to me

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

name: Emily Hall
subject: Join us in declaring your support
body:
For more than 100 years, missionaries have provided a beacon of hope

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z348e6osoncblm25rke241kut3ci3efd5f48iek0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1imeoj5c1h2bs)
---
Dear Friend,

For more than 100 years, missionaries have provided a beacon of hope in a world where so many have yet to hear the gospel. Right now, around the globe, 3,500 missionaries share the transforming gospel message of Jesus. They do this because individuals like you provide the support they need.

We are called by Scripture to play our part in bringing His teachings to all nations, tribes, people, and languages. As we live out this mission in our everyday lives, it's crucial we also show support for our missionaries with financial support and encouragement.

Will you encourage global missionaries today by committing to support their work? By signing this declaration, you're stating:

**" I am committed to helping solve the world's greatest problem -- spiritual lostness -- by supporting global missionaries, which ensures that the International Mission Board can send and sustain a growing missionary presence among unengaged and unreached people groups."**

Your validation of this commitment not only empowers our missionary teams but also gives support for global missionaries and their worldwide reach with the love of Christ.

[**Pledge your support today by signing our declaration.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z86jhmfaunm2fjdjlm0o7ovilmtd8iauhfp0e358_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1imeoj5c1h2bs)

Together, let's bring the gospel message of Jesus to those who have yet to hear it.

In His service,
Emily Hall
Prayer Content Specialist
IMB Prayer Office

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: Our course on the American Founding—Now on DVD
body:
I'd like to invite you to join me in Hillsdale College's newest free course studying the greatest Christian apologist of the 20th century, C.S. Lewis.

| | |
---
| | | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znaabu43sf0h36m2v1p2hdvm9fu6leg6tf5r8tvo_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1imeoj2c3h2bs) [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj1os0i02g2aknosgvlfrce3qp2ht20vep3pbc68_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1imeoj2c3h2bs) | Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z30ciunp4s1siom6lndcuj7gbd72nr4ejjfed8l0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1imeoj2c3h2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That’s why we’re so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale’s Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn’t known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders’ political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a “deep and long-forgotten pit.”

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That’s why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **“The Real American Founding: A Conversation,”** by clicking the link below.

I hope you’ll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g8odX1IWGzd9pXRUbw7umQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRng6wsP0ToaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90ZWFtLXNjYWxpc2UvY29vcmRpbmF0ZWQtYW5kLXByZXBsYW5uZWQtam9obnNvbi8_cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTA3X1dHLVJPTi4xMTIyMzlfdDE0MzEzMDktMTc1NiZleF90aWQ9MjAyNDAxMDdfV0ctUk9OLjExMjIzOV90MTQzMTMwOS0xNzU2JnV0bV9jb250ZW50PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMiZ4dW52PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMlcDc3BjQgplnrr8oGWk6YHEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g8odX1IWGzd9pXRUbw7umQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRng6wsP0ToaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90ZWFtLXNjYWxpc2UvY29vcmRpbmF0ZWQtYW5kLXByZXBsYW5uZWQtam9obnNvbi8_cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTA3X1dHLVJPTi4xMTIyMzlfdDE0MzEzMDktMTc1NiZleF90aWQ9MjAyNDAxMDdfV0ctUk9OLjExMjIzOV90MTQzMTMwOS0xNzU2JnV0bV9jb250ZW50PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMiZ4dW52PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMlcDc3BjQgplnrr8oGWk6YHEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not next month - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g8odX1IWGzd9pXRUbw7umQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRng6wsP0ToaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90ZWFtLXNjYWxpc2UvY29vcmRpbmF0ZWQtYW5kLXByZXBsYW5uZWQtam9obnNvbi8_cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTA3X1dHLVJPTi4xMTIyMzlfdDE0MzEzMDktMTc1NiZleF90aWQ9MjAyNDAxMDdfV0ctUk9OLjExMjIzOV90MTQzMTMwOS0xNzU2JnV0bV9jb250ZW50PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMiZ4dW52PXR2LXJvbi0yMDI0MDExMlcDc3BjQgplnrr8oGWk6YHEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

That will be the difference between victory and defeat. So what do you say? Can I count you in?

name: Huffines Liberty Foundation
subject: Giving Power Over Immigration Back to the States
body:
The U.S. government is radically changing the nature of our country through its open borders policy.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-q/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Giving Power Over Immigration Back to the States**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, January 11, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing our latest white paper, [_Giving Power Over Immigration Back to the States_.](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-j/)Unlike today, where the federal government has almost unchallenged authority over immigration policy, in years past, states often had more control over immigration than the United States. That changed in the late 1800s when the U.S. Supreme Court greatly expanded federal power through an expansive interpretation of Congress's enumerated power "to establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" in Article I Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution.Texas has rightly sought to expand its ability to deal with illegal aliens. Even though it has failed in the face of federal assertions of questionable power, Texas should not give up this approach. Texas should assert its authority under Article 1, Section 10 of the Constitution to declare the current flood of illegal aliens crossing our border an invasion and shut down illegal border crossings itself.Yet Texas should not give up hope of changing federal law on this issue. As immigration reform legislation works its way through Congress, Texas should push its representatives in Congress to expand the power of states to deal directly with illegal immigration. This would include allowing states to fully enforce federal immigration laws, make a violation of federal immigration law a state crime, and make it illegal for illegal immigrants to apply for, solicit, or perform work.The U.S. government is radically changing the nature of our country through its open borders policy. Returning more authority to the states would restore some of the balance of our system of federalism and make significant progress in getting our immigration problem under control. [Read Paper](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-t/) **JUST IN:** Don Huffines' latest op-ed in Gateway Pundit: _[To Save America,](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-i/)__[We Must Secure the Border](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-h/)._ [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-k/) [Read Op-ed](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vkkkjhd-yuddtktydi-u/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.###
### _Help us advance liberty and prosperity in Texas:_

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: David Hogg
subject: You don’t have to be obsessed with politics to know our country is in a bad place.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
Hey Peter, can I get minute of your time today for something important?
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T08d3ee02-e442-4498-86ff-685ed66ac96c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td9e38b41-ebd8-4f57-ad77-7a9d64342767/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tba280a54-8c9c-4c32-a2aa-7de59a6098dc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7f2c8c31-235b-4b4d-a2f4-fffd34875bbc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

## eBay Fined $3 Million for Terror Campaign
E-commerce giant eBay agreed Thursday to pay a $3 million criminal penalty for [deliberate harassment and cyber-stalking](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uhDAQhJ_GdEZeGw4oKK6huyhFpJRoz17AiX-Q7Rzi7SNSp_1Gmhl9n4_5gdbZsL6hp7EscUZd7Itm4CC5bOamMuNCJElVNEInWnHrm0FV2_hsQRiUQH2Pi1o0DG2njOmfizYGwVR2lEI2AkCCaFtQ9dBJgAE70en-pjpgjSBjS0z1V7ShbLS4M74o1Tr6yo1bKXtm6s7kxOR0HEftc7gyJicK_CczOfkY6GRy0tHvGCxdjJ54clwTUeYl8h1Prri3ztkYLpAoR_cirjdMK2V-TfJc0H3bsPKsMRh0TE6Y-P0O_t18PKo0mv24KvKtY41YPVr3d7P8K-03AAD__303b2M) of a Massachusetts couple who ran a newsletter covering the company. As part of a [terror campaign](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvTni7rAxA0OXbOna0SLHOaYlxgKUKP--SueOnz496el9XZaLjynut09_F9fWvHhu8SELDIAD6kX3wa0iKNSLA6NGNc3aUr-5VbMaabKE_jpSWJHFgMzAYoiMHvvoUKFWAAhqHIFO1iCA9UYZnicy0GklIbZcTt857m2TNb3yQ8qJ871PbmvtqB19dHju8OyPXZ71fb1HaZGTdHiWq38N9YhBSh0480_JnjepQ20SdynDm0rSmpTBekam8cpB82z8CjPQjGwgWIukqS8uHM-YUqyT6bS63X1MfzLt3zS_AQAA__9h72OU) against the couple, several eBay employees sent packages to the couple filled with spiders and cockroaches, a bloody pig's mask, and a funeral wreath. The company also signed the couple up for emails from an irritable-bowel-syndrome support group and posted their home address online with announcements inviting strangers to yard sales and parties. Seven eBay executives and contractors [have been convicted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1vpDAQxvFPY7pB9tgsS0Gx0onmtKfrUiKDB3YSvyDsLCKfPtrUaZ9f8-j_dh_vlj3H9Z8N1JcljXYu_KRRgUJAM5rK9QsRkq6oV61s5OVqOl09ek2TNg2pxXWymZyhRjrXobu2ZpbaUMU9SjRSKVSyaZSuuxaV6mwr2_l60a0SRpLjkvb6PXEsD1r8mZ6013MKle8fpWxZ6JvAQeBwHEcdcnyZwIEifGaBQ0iRToHDnMJmI9Nro8mekCkWmHcuPGewMPmU3AkbrxBs_oCYDuACGTZ7clzBgobA3nOKsHAkgYPd4XZT4f_Xn7_V3rvteHG-tMLINVj2Py_Lr82-AwAA__8jh22S) for their involvement in the scheme. Thursday's $3 million fine -- and an agreement that eBay will retain a corporate compliance monitor for three years -- brings an end to the prosecution.
## Hertz Dumping 20,000 Electric Cars

Today's edition is brought to you by . | eBay Fined $3 Million for Terror Campaign E-commerce giant eBay agreed Thursday to pay a $3 million criminal penalty for of a Massachusetts couple who ran a newsletter covering the company. As part of a against the couple, several eBay employees sent packages to the couple filled with spiders and cockroaches, a bloody pig's mask, and a funeral wreath. The company also signed the couple up for emails from an irritable-bowel-syndrome support group and posted their home address online with announcements inviting strangers to yard sales and parties. Seven eBay executives and contractors for their involvement in the scheme. Thursday's $3 million fine -- and an agreement that eBay will retain a corporate compliance monitor for three years -- brings an end to the prosecution. Hertz Dumping 20,000 Electric Cars Hertz is selling off (EVs), about a third of its electric fleet, just two years after announcing a major pivot to electric cars. The rental giant will replace the cars with gas-powered vehicles. Hertz said the electric cars had were involved in more collisions than its regular vehicles. The used EVs, including Teslas, will be put on the market for consumers to buy at reduced prices. The news comes as the market for EVs has slowed and inventory is piling up at many car dealers. High repair costs, particularly for Teslas, is not a new issue, though Hertz gave no reason for why the vehicles had more collisions. Trump Civil Fraud Trial Wraps Up Donald Trump's 44-day civil fraud case in New York , but not before Trump got in a few closing remarks. The judge had barred him from speaking today, but Trump gave a brief speech anyway. Trump told the court that the case was politically motivated and in particular Letitia James for "a political witchhunt." At stake is a $370 million fine and the ability for Trump to do business in New York. A final decision is expected from Judge Arthur Engoron within a couple of weeks. body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd8908c1009c4b36bfa94dc7426d9f81&_e=X1bE9prcWlEuYhy63wP_M2fp8wQ3-zL04S3ElP00MzS-DRHS86KJck9bb36Q5L0jZfDnu_1liEst--rFxeEZIlxfPejDJdhgsgWVNLHyKBw_6HIjTQ7YzborsHroZ7Mlp87r7wjTylOdzxk2XiIAXQCmKkPKM5kaPFcMUDlxVJolFAcJQiKKi6XZ6Kf8sJx5W_xGjB8iE_bybGW040NyP616iIWsNw5H7OKzJaguuLRqb-v9gMI2qw1dhe9_ReaOLmvtLa0LZtf1b3Aa85vTogsfkcMhIDWrSvEN-BbXHzFZD5dSUmOHgbMMdH_YIlOOA8GvopQs9IFFPc9UN1qAkqbKcZzUvW4tVrpb2TOF8hBdY30zoAnLnTOA2Ryt3q5EwGcMJwQqAzfm525Lv5tM4wKXnph8LBIkV58mC6SZ0LKxRGWuPmUyOEFZGYP59PRs)

Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd8908c1009c4b36bfa94dc7426d9f81&_e=X1bE9prcWlEuYhy63wP_M2fp8wQ3-zL04S3ElP00MzS-DRHS86KJck9bb36Q5L0jZfDnu_1liEst--rFxeEZIlxfPejDJdhgsgWVNLHyKBw_6HIjTQ7YzborsHroZ7Mlp87r7wjTylOdzxk2XiIAXQCmKkPKM5kaPFcMUDlxVJolFAcJQiKKi6XZ6Kf8sJx5W_xGjB8iE_bybGW040NyP616iIWsNw5H7OKzJaguuLRqb-v9gMI2qw1dhe9_ReaOLmvtLa0LZtf1b3Aa85vTokTskRkQc2fBZw61BMEQIbDIrH2T0oP5aAG4O1o7pMMgMmaCg9rVCGU6N1Ag74MKoWqp_8yP06tXNJOUSkzJPkgoH1GSs-x7eRWEqrfqt5zIhPq_Bg7fG-XGywAbv4MSqcds7lTnocswGSFZN_LdOYKJlez08HhyXuIflj7f-veH)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6e994ef61f5414bbefe9bfc4a752849&_e=z31gF0gj0nSz2Ez-s7E1UAcai4Nwha9QFWKp9AwsZkmQLB-fEbzS9dabgrUArYRpywzsSpag1dGKjHnaKCSCVIaUZCwCZWqnNnqctlUN3RiONNi9WTWCv6jxr7wMkSwUNunkYfsNB3SFhrxFGiYAk0Vitzgr5UK1YzJB2Oiq4NTMDvT4IvXepgSCu4n4_y5S7YHYhUOId-1uBQMrmQBNUftcR3K-_U6VGmDHnh08IJ-K4TSp6nQSv6soFM9234wunVTwDx_opY3f5UwpfP1R8CR0BM1lWYpgje3YVXn_H6J5SoVwdsz-qpr0RC2GHmlZ7hRwXtCGVB498QcSV3PQ8QxbQP79ggBgVGHGANtF8SZbzonOCU4JuWfbd3zob-iWNY_mwAYOpOVLNCTS7nHq3LC7eahyE8ibJ9B3HkxLeVn_D5blYjMxdkI3wXa4dTgM3c0pBvh7dPT0KegCb3zExTtqZTrAOmWwxLazz5Dov3M70owkbny7HELkiqddzNm_d9dNRznJzpjI4pTO4Qbap0Tm5fwFlXjt0QqXMQnqZoUEAeLJLjTZKnGh3pPhY6wKMIKEIBWuURxt3urzHlJ5OS8H76w1l8hmVPA1n0-IJtTTJwwGZH6Je1fDHOpJRIUe14lVf5umdXI5--8P-zp8xQ%3D%3D "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6e994ef61f5414bbefe9bfc4a752849&_e=z31gF0gj0nSz2Ez-s7E1UAcai4Nwha9QFWKp9AwsZkmQLB-fEbzS9dabgrUArYRpywzsSpag1dGKjHnaKCSCVIaUZCwCZWqnNnqctlUN3RiONNi9WTWCv6jxr7wMkSwUNunkYfsNB3SFhrxFGiYAk0Vitzgr5UK1YzJB2Oiq4NTMDvT4IvXepgSCu4n4_y5S7YHYhUOId-1uBQMrmQBNUftcR3K-_U6VGmDHnh08IJ-K4TSp6nQSv6soFM9234wunVTwDx_opY3f5UwpfP1R8CR0BM1lWYpgje3YVXn_H6J5SoVwdsz-qpr0RC2GHmlZ7hRwXtCGVB498QcSV3PQ8QxbQP79ggBgVGHGANtF8SZbzonOCU4JuWfbd3zob-iWNY_mwAYOpOVLNCTS7nHq3LC7eahyE8ibJ9B3HkxLeVn_D5blYjMxdkI3wXa4dTgM3c0pBvh7dPT0KegCb3zExTtqZTrAOmWwxLazz5Dov3M70owkbny7HELkiqddzNm_IH-iFBnDhywREb-PFuiloy_iTIW7LA5ObKUq1TMlhiczGMkE5OTf9uf3MNF1EAobi-jFX88XOlusHIC6n9nnOfTFhxvc1vwOy_pcs9PEwTcGGM5kmzt2T-rnbkCBA3Otze7xY5V6Vk8UlKp3xRa_Cw%3D%3D)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

name: (1) Ron DeSantis, me
subject: There's one answer as to why
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
It's time to start winning for the American people again and I will fight for 8 straight years to get this country again. YOU are who I am fighting for.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)
---
Hey Friend, it's Ron DeSantis. At a time like this, when we're up against the most critical battle we've faced yet, I believe it's up to me to remind you who I'm fighting for and why it's so important to me to earn your support in time for the first nominating contest. I have a personal stake in this race, friend. I'm running to leave a greater America to the generation that comes after us--_the generation of my three young children._ It matters to me that they grow up in a nation as free as the one promised to us by way of the Constitution of the United States. And it is critical that this happen **now. 2028 is too long to wait for a leader to take action, shut our border down, bring back the American Dream, and keep the woke insanity from driving our country into the ground.** We are just DAYS away from the first contest for the Republican presidential nomination.
---
| | [HELP ME FIGHT: DONATE $20 TODAY](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b3ef9193be5cc956d4ac4178539f8e5da01e7e1fda28c00f8b93976be99a4ed7b2848d998b1e0b0197c79262fd9f99cb6)
---
I am running because I cannot sit idly by while the decline of our country continues. WE CAN PUT AN END TO IT. But to get this done, I am counting on every Republican to ******[**stand up and fight with me**](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)****** to cause a ripple effect across this country. _This starts in Iowa on Monday._ The fact is this: the Iowa voters are facing a choice to nominate... 1) Someone who puts his own issues at the forefront of his campaign and presidency, OR 2) Someone who puts her million-dollar donors at the forefront of her campaign for presidency, OR 3) Me, a candidate in this race to fight for you, win for America, and lead us to our Great American Comeback. This is why I humbly ask for your support before we miss our shot. We don't have time to wait around and hope the Left comes to their senses and stops shoving nonsense down the throats of kids and consumers across the country. America will be too far gone if we don't choose now to fight.
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b84e9a59cfad0480332f3e0b12bde2b6caaa96602a54f3b270cb099fc924278e7fab461be98dfdddc6c3acb081cb24ee1)
---
_**Friend**_** _, I am counting on your help to reach everyone I can before votes are cast. I am counting on YOU to drive this election forward. This is the moment we have fought for. Please help out today if you can._** Thank you for allowing me to fight for your support.
---
| [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)
---
Ron DeSantis

---
| | | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)
---
| |
**🚨 ATTENTION 🚨** Our grassroots team drives our every success, and we know we ask a lot of you to help us win this critical election. As this race continues to heat up, we will be relying on our supporters to help us go the distance, and we want to make sure we respect your preferences when we reach out to you. If you'd like to receive fewer emails from our team, please click **[here.](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b6da22f61443b80a8526a52249c69f3edc30e9e86cf15df44fc775a3a5a02283ba6dc4fed1ce944975c40865ddccbefee "here.")**

---

**Volunteer!**
We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!
---
| | [Sign up here!](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56bbbe229fb01500cab24978be5eaf3e210a71fa1bdf9b58ab68bbc92285bfee7dc92f72966187dc6e99a73dc6d65a58eba)
---
| | |
_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4b33ac683b2ba56b7916e1ff2edb923573fae921c756ddf1dbb346df5765d680147e1e2c99afef5cb7d3115affdf454077c337c8a3d5d188)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

# ▶️: The Do-Nothing 118th Congress

**Peter -** my goal is clear: to represent the people of Texas's 8th district in the United States Congress.
However, it is evident that the 118th American Congress has left much to be desired. In a sea of 724 votes, only 24 bills managed to pass—a reminder of inefficiency and neglect. The fundamental purpose of our representatives should be to address the needs of the people. Instead, Washington has become a stage for cultural battles and discord, sidelining the pressing concerns of everyday Americans.
[**Before delving deeper, I'm reaching out to ask for your support by considering a donation to our campaign today. Your contribution could truly make a profound impact on our efforts for Texas's 8th district.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=d14c698f54&e=a2a46ff12c)

[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=464e137d76&e=a2a46ff12c)
We, the people, demand accountability from those entrusted with our welfare. The votes cast during this past legislative session, from renaming VA clinics to minting coins, do little to alleviate the genuine worries of our communities.
How does this positively impact our children's education, ensure accessible healthcare, or alleviate our financial burdens? **It leaves the average citizen wondering, "What about us?"**
The year 2023 has been riddled with deceit, scandal, and unproductive infighting. We simply cannot afford to perpetuate the same cycle. It's time for a change—a change that brings about representation from an average American perspective.
[**I'm here to be your voice in Washington, committed to working tirelessly for you. Let's elect someone who's ready to serve you, the people. If you can stand by me in this and chip in today, I would appreciate it so mu ch.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=af3b9dd051&e=a2a46ff12c)

One of the most frequently misrepresented federal statutes--often falsely used to justify unconstitutional presidential war powers--is the War Powers Resolution (or Act) ([50 U.S.C. §§ 1541-1550](https://substack.com/redirect/a005f242-740d-4e85-8528-2492e007ffad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
If only more people would read it.
Justin Amash is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pu9RtG_rQDOZySNpfp-hMH8hhuY3UHLLoNrPNCGDo7c?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=140610577)
Contrary to what you may have heard about the War Powers Resolution, it does **not** allow the president to take military action for any reason for 60-90 days without congressional approval so long as the president notifies Congress within 48 hours.
Section 1541(c) of the War Powers Resolution states clearly:
"The constitutional powers of the President as Commander-in-Chief to introduce United States Armed Forces into hostilities, or into situations where imminent involvement in hostilities is clearly indicated by the circumstances, **are exercised only pursuant to (1) a declaration of war, (2) specific statutory authorization, or (3) a national emergency created by attack upon the United States, its territories or possessions, or its armed forces.** "
**Of the three cited authorities, not one indicates a presidential power to take unilateral (without Congress's approval) offensive military action.**
The first two authorities allow the president to take offensive military action but only with Congress's express approval (Article I of the Constitution grants Congress the exclusive power to declare war). The third authority allows the president to take defensive military action without Congress's approval in the event of a specific type of national emergency, a sudden unforeseen attack on the United States (happening too quickly for Congress to meet) necessitating immediate action to protect Americans.
It's for this last situation (or for situations in which the president introduces forces into hostilities unlawfully) that the War Powers Resolution provides for the oft-mentioned 48-hour report to Congress (§ 1543) and 60-day (up to 90-day) timeline (§ 1544). If there's an attack in progress on the United States (i.e., **currently** happening), we expect the president to respond swiftly to neutralize the attack and protect Americans--and then we will hold the president to account.
The Framers of the Constitution agreed at the debates in the federal convention of 1787 that the president should have the "**power to repel sudden attacks** " but not the power to otherwise introduce forces into hostilities without congressional approval.
The War Powers Resolution does not confer any new authority on the president to take offensive military action without congressional approval--nor could it under our Constitution. It instead checks the president when, as the Framers contemplated, the president introduces our Armed Forces into hostilities to repel a sudden attack.

Dear Peter,
I believe we are standing on the cusp of a historic victory.
Why? Because we are running against the weakest candidates in American history, and the opportunity for change has never been more promising.
Trump and Biden have had their time in the Oval Office. Voters overwhelmingly express a desire for another option in this election. President Biden supporters admit their vote is driven more by fear of Trump's supposed threat to democracy than by genuine belief in his vision.
So in that sense, I've never met a real "Biden voter," only someone choosing the perceived lesser of two evils.
Right now, polls indicate that **I am outperforming both candidates** among Americans under 45 years old. I am leading by 10 points among Americans under 35. And in key battleground states, my average stands at an impressive 24%, **putting me within striking distance of victory**.
**_If we can pull 5% from each of our opponents to get to 34% ... we win._**

I’m running for re-election! In 2022, I was proud to help Republicans retake control of the House of Representatives. In the House, we’ve made important progress to secure the border, hold the Biden Administration accountable, strengthen our military, improve care for our veterans, and lower costs for families. But we’ve got so much more work left to do!! That’s why I’m throwing my hat back in the ring and continuing my lifetime of service to the country I love! https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=ef045053d3cc180bc4361d22d5bebcc7b51181c384cfe066ecf2438c84cb64cd32a27e351aea24eff15058ea7130bb25b0a0734b918b134e Whether it was serving my country in the Navy, serving my community as a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner, or serving my family as a stay-at-home mom when my husband was deployed overseas, I’ve always been focused on service to others. We have far too many people in Washington who think the people work for them and who have no idea what true service really means….far too many people more focused on advancing their personal agendas than they are making our country a safer and stronger place. That’s not me, and that’s why I’m committed to running for re-election so I can do more to shake up business as usual in Washington and continue actually solving problems for families all across the country. But we’ve got a real campaign on our hands. Joe Biden won my district by almost 2%, so we know the Democrats are going to do everything they can to take this seat back. They’ve recruited a far-Left Democrat to run against me, they’ve added me to their top target lists, and they’ve already had Dark Money Super PACs run ads attacking me. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=ef045053d3cc180bc4361d22d5bebcc7b51181c384cfe066ecf2438c84cb64cd32a27e351aea24eff15058ea7130bb25b0a0734b918b134e So now that I’ve officially kicked off my re-election campaign, I’m hoping you will make a donation to help us run hard and win this race. No one will outwork me and our team, but we need the funds to fund our voter contact program, our advertising campaign, and our turnout program. You have no idea how much your support means to me. I know times are tough, so the fact you are willing to devote some of your hard-earned money to support our campaign means everything. Thanks for supporting us in this fight! | | **Don’t Say I Didn’t Warn You 🚨**
---
| |
---
You’ve heard me speak and tweet the phrase “no border, no budget” for weeks, and here’s why it matters now more than ever. As you read this, there are [2,000 migrants](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOK6leL44BqFrNQBITlECWkcp-yR5rvP3dEh18QHJ51jpoNE0afW_1Qp1B68LSsCOcoY4W1GoI9sZNrM8jw33QiDsjhgU5WDhEjOkXiXe7LaqSTdh-9by9-1TcQca2DHZVepUqL4rz3qf60NmFyl44yilSjxyhswuTR6xkN0RUaknUJ_gewtAFFVz_Vbs3_zFT0TiVa7D2e_fzFYqy1cAfltPnmXhnB-ht9YLYD0VUg7JBM37b5N9zICvpm6WCrEGuulekQhjmRyGg4ETLFOhXFoOtKC2R9K6TnONC57dFGjpDi80fKIUO8LPLupAWosXjqQ%3D%3D) taking up residence in a New York City high school, leaving American students kicked to the curb and forced into remote learning. The whole fiasco has sparked [outrage](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOKxHHq9s_EctD3Zzbste-CbzLrbbkLeBicOwA-O0rXXLsGusYIfTPL-bzyp3BW_y3RSy3uj0kGNTfZFG6QA09IwUWFH2tn2BBKp2eIwRQPoGurZ1Uza3Wku8aTJ-z7EbseFXuOtmF6IgCC6inKUj7jnD4OXLNYeJMnZgVEJg-UcgR1xm4PTiZwnYRB9knqvchIzRJ0phqK3neuHb88OYE-dMj2hx3JZeYakYHVDTvPUVwFBaPx5AwHiMoQ0L8AabFFVu5ZMYPgQRQkup7UHAj94Ju5PCtY_vzfgipnpt1qLOD-9KB-c8tzAPcNjd-Wv8rP9K0_jnsTxI2IkWcX4R0CkcSUHmwKat_M7UFtpNJ0iVKc5gGovh6XScJPMJOTCNIpA%3D%3D)—and rightfully so. Truth be told, this is exactly what Republicans have been warning against. We told you there’d be hell to pay if we didn’t put a stop to the mess at our southern border, and now the issue is on our doorstep. The border crisis is spiraling out of control, and our own children are left to pick up the pieces. Schools are supposed to be where our children go to learn, grow, and succeed. We saw the [devastating consequences](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOK8gxTDDRMWF33IrAAjrFRKiGg0v2EUi7PUS54pZLWPIU19iv_q2WT45yeCVPyu5J32IrU0vaPY8PV0-aaEGnzvrkekxkEGzzVz-axSWq_0Sz766qlAC4Cq0bjtqXS134WrtYbPnEDG4RRWa-wY9zAxkOuw26TzNTHSUCafi2AYqLo7eSVKv6Isu5CMsrepL9zM_ki48rmtYUe9fKPQITX38pr7AB3aqewRz1oX_gXbx91Bw14jq4gMMZGWLdjpY88FV9Nxw0kQeHLH8sVhCdDvs%3D) of remote learning during the pandemic, and we can’t afford to go back to that—not even for a few days. Our kids deserve to be in the classroom with their teachers and peers, not glued to a screen at home. Turning schools into makeshift migrant housing facilities sets a dangerous precedent, and of course Democrat-led NYC would lead us down this pathway of destruction. What else would you expect from our sorry excuse for leadership in this country? Look no further than the White House to see the epitome of tomfoolery. President Biden and his crooked son have made a mockery of America with their never-ending circus act. Just take this week when it was Hunter’s chance to face the music for his crooked ways, but after just [17 minutes](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOK1WIN_qB4v7t8ilqvVK6WU4olySsyJYvXhY0qEDjckL8kRCHr4c6FCLeRgBJJpebeDwiPfjW1w5D2d0SURaPS9YSV_yEjMNxGWNvoHDtZfalbBAOStJsuCIqcQyK4nVLrbA1lf1sUpBgypl7xlElh2sQ-VxhmL-NA74fgcb-RxpfrmckoeM7-Y1gL2JIMyTb5RhRdreYkgZBtzkYclApoI8nKiIKzxU0pvqORVtOBssqfBKBJE2_bYy2RbZimHiXmTW4aDYdS0QQPBUwd63ZPvl4Beu5Oz8slOpKxV-KAtLJ) in the House Oversight Committee hearing, he made a run for it—just like he dodged [two lawful subpoenas.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOKxHHq9s_EctD3Zzbste-Cby5cvC_MXGUdRE-aebREn-GZlUDByqIaST1fWhmq3Pl7t04JFaLqsXdptq2L03Q6wHIgr8N5xPsr9HHxDirAqxaEHbKY8o3hjGGRHlooD1y-rr9dpBuhSnJaTiykFMLxqBCtjpM4DkOiR7iuyeXZAuR6kep1HBPOzfATMc0rm8kGlVuuhDgJLsaeC5mgKXUuULBnQhTp22VeI2xkqkakXci2ZQMBeAp5vip5hQxqvVa6p33Ww0fKeqsrYUEnKo8Nlo%3D) Is this the America we want, folks? Of course not. We can do better, and we must do better. Our children shouldn’t be ousted to make room for illegal immigrants, and our leaders shouldn’t be able to skirt the law and fly under the radar with their backward business dealings. The buck stops here. I won’t back down until we close that dadgum border, hold Hunter [in contempt of Congress](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9b10732beaac4bc6b48e24f847aa1da5&_e=e6ZwC8gNdlW77xQJnSbOK3SaGbX2Y6rJ0uNaBIPcGsHPjiH4j5G997J3Xl6kSRm1Gz-cf9W3mDrXbrY0z4OQQJk3t93vFViFlhe5uAUm4SoQd-A3qpcP0o7301mcY343fHORG0Pi5vadT6F2ttVT8HRK1eWmXk1iFBrVxNnjOwJNs_egohpo9KlGKzUEmu6wN5KY4mDDfA5LyVVFmwvTp8NwoB049QWzbIG9dhNiey0SdfphzrqU6UiAxMOpvGvWfirjCAqLy143vD3aLs8w7eRrlTo-LibULLj8syrJc9E%3D), and restore some much-needed sanity in this country. We’ve been counting down to 2024 for a while now—and thank goodness it’s finally here. Change is on the horizon, and it’s about time.

| | **A Lasting Legacy 🇺🇲**
---
---
| | As we prepare to celebrate Dr. King’s life and legacy, I want to emphasize the importance of reflecting on the lasting mark he made on our country. This holiday serves as a reminder of the civil rights leader’s tireless efforts to promote equality and justice, and we are a nation of people who are forever grateful. His words from the famous “I Have a Dream” speech continue to resonate as we confront the challenges of today, and they serve as an example of what we can accomplish when we are unified. Let’s recommit ourselves to the ongoing work of coming together to ensure liberty and justice for all.

We send you a lot of emails, for sure. And I know you can’t donate to all of them.
#

Peter — good morning. I’ll keep this brief.
I know you probably didn’t wake up this morning and think that today was the day you’d make your first donation to my campaign, but that is exactly what I need you to do.
We send you a lot of emails, for sure. And I know you can’t donate to all of them. But I hope you’ll chip into this one, because Kari Lake put out her 2023 Q4 numbers earlier this week. We’re waiting for Kyrsten Sinema to release hers, too.
Fighting it out on one front is tough — but it’s doable. As a Marine, I can tell you that you never want to fight a battle on two fronts. But if Kyrsten Sinema gets in, that’s what we’ll have to do.
And whether we’re successful or not is going to come down to whether we have the resources to defeat both of them. And that comes down to emails like this, because these emails and people like you are our biggest source of donations.
So I’m asking you, humbly:

I pledge to walk away before becoming part of the establishment. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7bdc3d895263/why-i-will-cap-myself-at-4-terms?e=d03ae83678)
---
|

[](https://jared2024.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=24ab0ae566056870479dadd16&id=c7fab4ceb9&e=d03ae83678)
|
---
## We need more public servants not legacy chasers.
Howdy Peter,

Some voters have criticized me for supporting term limits and even voluntarily promising to cap myself at 4 terms. **What can be more noble than returning power to the people?**
In a perfect world, where politics isn’t an industry and voters know the name of even the poorest guy or gal running for office, our current system gives sufficient power to the people to elect a new Congressman every two years.
However, in the real world, money determines who voters know. It costs a lot of money to spread a message to hundreds of thousands of people, so that on election day they can show up and feel informed about a candidate.
Incumbents have a financial home field advantage for a few reasons:
1. Name Recognition
2. Established Donor Networks (PACS, etc.)
3. Media Access
4. Elite D.C. and Austin Networks

No matter how much you may like me as your representative, **I will not seek re-election after 4 terms.** Because longevity in Congress isn’t my goal, **I’m freer to vote according to your wishes and not the D.C. establishment’s.** I won’t be beholden to PACs or special interest groups. Just you. That’s the way it should be.
It would be great all candidates felt this way of their own free will, but they don’t. That’s why I support term limits.
God Bless America!Jared Lovelace

How can we end the IRS while increasing government revenues without raising taxes? The answer is simple - it's called the FairTax plan.
Think you know the FairTax? Think again.
FairTax is one of the most transformative economic policies of our time. It's an innovative approach that includes repealing the 16th Amendment and overhauling the current tax system.
But what does this mean for you and for America?

subject: How Speaker Johnson could win the spending fight
body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10407595?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

Last week the Washington cartel was elated over news that Speaker Johnson had cut a $1.7 trillion “bipartisan” spending deal with Chuck Schumer. Now they’re fretting that conservatives may have derailed it. They’re right, and for good reason.

If Speaker Mike Johnson makes a series of strategic moves now, _he could outmaneuver Chuck Schumer_ and ensure $73 billion in non-defense (NDD) spending cuts (what we also call the woke and weaponized government bureaucracy). Let me explain.

Last year, Kevin McCarthy struck a debt limit deal with Democrats which put caps on NDD spending to make it look like he came away with cuts. But accompanying it was a hand-shake "side deal" of $69 billion that would backfill any losses in spending.

But with McCarthy and his side deals out of the picture, a critical leverage point in the fight has re-emerged. Under the terms of the original deal, pre-negotiated spending caps will automatically trigger across-the-board 9% cuts or “sequesters” on non-defense spending if it’s in a final spending bill of the year.

Few Democrats or Republicans anticipated this turn of events, _**but that’s precisely why Speaker Johnson must seize this leverage point and pass a full year continuing resolution**_ that triggers the 9% “sequester” or $73 billion in cuts to nondefense spending.
---
| **Russ Vought on War Room Explaining How Speaker Johnson Could Win the Spending Fight**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1eab27c118&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| It’s forcing cuts in spending that _Chuck Schumer and Kevin McCarthy never believed_ would come to fruition.

Conservatives have more leverage than the media, D.C. cartel, or Democrats want you to believe.

Keep the pressure up. Conservatives can still snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. Tell your Representative no deal is better than what Speaker Johnson and Chuck Schumer have offered so far.
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Citizens for Renewing America

And the support this email generates will quite literally decide whether we keep this seat red- or whether Joe Biden walks away with another win.

Hey team , it's Harry Dunn here, one of the Capitol police officers who defended the U.S. Capitol against MAGA insurrectionists just three years ago and testified in front of the January 6th Committee.
I've got an important announcement: I'm hoping to make my return to DC – but not as a Capitol police officer. I'm officially running to serve Maryland's 3rd Congressional district in the U.S. House.
I’m counting on your support to get there. Can you rush $10 or more to me and Seth Moulton become a Founding Donor of my campaign? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-dunn]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-dunn]
Here’s the thing team, I never thought I would run for office. Growing up, I wanted to be just like my dad, who was an athlete and a U.S. Air Force Veteran. I played football and earned an athletic scholarship that sent me to college. (I was pretty good, but being 6-foot-7 sure didn’t hurt!)
But wearing a football uniform taught me something special: it gave me purpose and made me feel a part of something bigger than myself.
So when I put on my Capitol police uniform for the first time over 15 years ago to protect our nation’s Capitol, it felt right.
But I never thought I’d see the day that our democracy would be attacked by Donald Trump and an army of insurrectionists that HE directed to the Capitol.
I couldn't have been any closer to the chaos of January 6. I put my life on the line during the violence and destruction that Trump encouraged. So trust and believe when I tell you: we cannot allow our democracy to be in the hands of these MAGA-extremists.
I fought for our democracy and our Capitol once as Officer Dunn, and I'll do it again as Congressman Dunn.

Harry Dunn

Friends-
I hope your week has been good! We’ve had a week full of exciting things, and I wanted to share some of those with you.
Earlier this week we had a press conference with legislators, AARP of Virginia, and advocates to announce legislation for a Prescription Drug Affordability Board (PDAB) for the 2024 session. Some patrons of the bill, Senator Creigh Deeds, Delegate Karrie Delaney, and Delegate Nadarius Clark, provided insight into why they are advocating for a PDAB in 2024.
You can watch the full press conference here:
https://youtu.be/8J-4x2GjeHk?feature=shared [https://youtu.be/8J-4x2GjeHk?feature=shared]
Legislation that we are supporting , like the Prescription Drug Affordability Board, has now been drafted and filed! We are proud to be supporting so many bills that will lower the cost of living in Virginia.
https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB570 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB570] https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+SB274 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+SB274]
On Wednesday the session began! The 2024 session started with an historic achievement: Delegate Don Scott became Speaker of the House of Delegates making him the first ever Black speaker in Virginia's 405 year history. Speaker Scott is a legislator who shares our vision for a more affordable Virginia, and we are thrilled for his speakership.
Read about this historic achievement here:
https://www.npr.org/2024/01/10/1223953846/don-scott-becomes-first-black-speaker-in-virginia-legislatures-400-year-history [https://www.npr.org/2024/01/10/1223953846/don-scott-becomes-first-black-speaker-in-virginia-legislatures-400-year-history]
Before the holidays we asked supporters if they would share their stories of high prescription costs with us. We are still in need of stories, especially now that session has started! If you are interested in using your voice to inform lawmakers about high prescription costs and the need for a PDAB, please use the form below:
Visit the form [https://forms.gle/qorWD7qsMRSW5Q1UA]
We look forward to more weeks like this during the 2024 session!

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._
