The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. _[If you were forwarded this newsletter, you can sign up to receive the Kernel every week by clicking here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76978084/448978526/1416943042?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDQwNWI3OS03MGIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wp-Bzd90n37z68QhgwtZZpRYWla3zN1RAHCj5CIqTYY=&emci=e2eb953b-6bb1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=8d405b79-70b1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535)_ **** _Indiana House Democrats Unveil Economic Agenda_ Soon after the Indiana General Assembly convened on Monday, House Democrats presented their plan for economic progress throughout the state. The plan is designed to create an economy that recognizes the importance of workers, families, teachers, parents, retirees and so many other Hoosiers that call our state home. House Democrats’ “Economic Freedom Agenda” includes policies that benefit Hoosier workers, such as raising the statewide minimum wage and making union dues tax deductible. To help Indiana families, Democrats also hope to create tax credits for homeowners, increase deductions for renters, and finally pass fair housing protections. On education, House Democrats are advocating for bold long-term investments in students, including funding for universal pre-K and childcare tax credits. Finally, House Democrats look to protect Hoosiers by defending Medicaid and benefits for retirees. This comprehensive economic agenda will unleash Indiana’s potential through a plan that works for all Hoosiers.
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76978085/448978527/1001043624?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDQwNWI3OS03MGIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wp-Bzd90n37z68QhgwtZZpRYWla3zN1RAHCj5CIqTYY=&emci=e2eb953b-6bb1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=8d405b79-70b1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535)**[_Share INDems_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76978086/448978528/1001043624?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDQwNWI3OS03MGIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wp-Bzd90n37z68QhgwtZZpRYWla3zN1RAHCj5CIqTYY=&emci=e2eb953b-6bb1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=8d405b79-70b1-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535) ****_Holcomb Omits Health Care Access_ On Tuesday, Indiana Governor Eric Holcomb delivered his last State of the State Address as governor. In his 30 minute speech, Governor Holcomb failed to mention health care access or reproductive health. Rural hospitals are closing at unprecedented rates, creating health inequities across the state. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Indiana House Democrats Unveil Economic Agenda Soon after the Indiana General Assembly convened on Monday, House Democrats presented their plan for economic progress throughout the state. The plan is designed to create an economy that recognizes the importance of workers, families, teachers, parents, retirees and so many other Hoosiers that call our state home. House Democrats’ “Economic Freedom Agenda” includes policies that benefit Hoosier workers, such as raising the statewide minimum wage and making union dues tax deductible. To help Indiana families, Democrats also hope to create tax credits for homeowners, increase deductions for renters, and finally pass fair housing protections. On education, House Democrats are advocating for bold long-term investments in students, including funding for universal pre-K and childcare tax credits. Finally, House Democrats look to protect Hoosiers by defending Medicaid and benefits for retirees. This comprehensive economic agenda will unleash Indiana’s potential through a plan that works for all Hoosiers. Holcomb Omits Health Care Access On Tuesday, Indiana Governor Eric Holcomb delivered his last State of the State Address as governor. In his remarks, Holcomb discussed the need for improved education, economic development, and taxes. But what he left out speaks volumes. In his 30 minute speech, Governor Holcomb failed to mention health care access or reproductive health. Rural hospitals are closing at unprecedented rates, creating health inequities across the state. Extreme Republican abortion bans have also limited care and forced Hoosiers to travel to receive the reproductive care they need. Hoosiers have a right to healthcare, and they shouldn’t have to bear the burden of mismanagement and poor leadership. Indiana needs change. The Indiana Democratic Party will continue to fight for expanded healthcare along with prudent fiscal responsibility. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. House and Senate Democrats Launch Joint Agenda House and Senate Democrats came together on Wednesday to launch their joint agenda focused on Hoosier working families. Together, the caucuses have proposed legislation tackling the most pressing issues, including childcare availability, protecting healthcare access, property tax relief, and more. In addition, Statehouse Democrats are fighting to give Hoosiers a choice at the ballot box with direct, citizen-led ballot initiatives. ** Become a Delegate to the 2024 State and National Conventions Stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates on the 2024 Delegate Selection process. Head to for more information about how to be a part of history next year in Chicago. Thinking About Running For Office in 2024? In 2024, we're looking to have a record number of Democrats running for office up and down the ballot all across Indiana. Having Democrats on the ballot for statewide, district, and local offices next year will ensure Hoosiers have as many choices as possible at the ballot box. If you're thinking about running for office, or just want to learn more, and a member of our team will be touch. Get Involved! Opportunities to Volunteer Near You! Municipal campaign season is heating up, and campaigns around the state are needing help! Find an event near you and get involved to help Upcoming Candidate Trainings Friday, January 19th: 1 p.m. ET: Setting Up Your Local Democratic Party’s Structure. Join the National Democratic Training Committee for a free training on how to organize and advance your local Democratic Party. Discuss getting started, best practices, and how to recruit members. | Dear Team Joby for Congress Member ,We are thrilled to share the latest highlights from Joby's campaign, illustrating exciting momentum and commitment to positive change. Here's a snapshot of recent activities and ways to get involved:**Mark Your Calendar! Sunday Canvassing Event in Palo Alto:**
* Join us for our canvassing event this [**Sunday, January 14, from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM in Palo Alto at Cameron Park**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65a1be4b2dc001478685aecc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSelaUhprlyU0Ghudqkrl0vn5I5QDkfcGVUSaOBE-7Y_aOrq6Q%2Fviewform%3Fusp%3Dsf_link&w=6514833727955b66bdb4f35b&c=b_65a150b3a862073316c12376&l=en-US&s=e-4cE52VbBtQx2gG8turSvLswiI%3D). It's a fantastic opportunity to connect with the community and share Joby's vision for a brighter future. Come out ready to knock on doors!

**Leadership Discussions:**
* Joby recently spoke with two House members, one Senator, multiple CEOs, and school deans, enriching our campaign strategy with diverse perspectives.
* In a notable meeting, he discussed bipartisan efforts to tackle climate change, infrastructure, and economic growth with a New Jersey Congressman.

**Community Engagement:**
* Joby connected with the community, meeting multiple local Jewish organizations to better understand and address their needs.
* Additionally, he participated in a Q and A with members of the Arab American community in Silicon Valley, organized by the Arab American Cultural Center in Sunnyvale. Discussions focused on fostering collaboration and identifying shared goals.

**Endorsement Milestones:**
* Joby participated in endorsement interviews with prestigious groups such as the Sierra Club, and AFL-CIO and presented and vision in front of the San Francisco Chronicle editorial board, marking a crucial step in gaining widespread support and recognition
* More endorsement interviews are coming up this week!

**Team Highlights:**
* Our newly appointed Campaign Manager, **Robert Wool** brings a wealth of experience as a former political advisor to Tom Steyer and Democratic Party consultant.
* Serving as our Deputy Campaign Manager, **Tami Scott** plays a crucial role in overseeing various aspects of our campaign's operations.
* As our Finance Director, **Cate Beard** serves a pivotal role in managing the financial aspects of our campaign. Her expertise ensures the smooth and effective operation of our fundraising efforts.
* **Jared Kamrass** is running our media strategy. We hope you are as excited as we are for some creative ads.
* **Matt Liebman** and **Emma Caccamo** are managing our mail, materials, and messaging. We can’t wait to show everything off.
* In her role as Compliance Manager, **JenEve Slate** r ensures that our campaign adheres to all legal and regulatory requirements, maintaining transparency and accountability.
* We proudly added a great advisor to our dedicated team, **Jeff Levine** , former Ambassador to Estonia nominated under President Barack Obama.

We also have a robust social media, marketing, and communications team made up of PhD, graduate, and undergraduate students across the country - more info on them to come in a future newsletter! Together, we bring expertise in campaigns, politics, policy, and community organizing, committed to creating positive change in CA-16.If you can’t make canvassing on Sunday, please join Joby at events on Monday:MLK Day Schedule: 8am **\- Hike with Joby** \- Windy Hill (message hello@jobyforcongress.com if you can join)10am - **Volunteer with Joby** \- **Tree Planting in East Palo Alto with the Canopy**(sign up through the JCC)11am **Volunteer with Joby -** **Green Hearts Make Clean Parks in Mitchell Park**(sign up through the JCC)5pm - Additional **door knocking** \- if you aren’t free on Sunday, join us on Monday! **Lastly, it is time to start ordering yard signs!** [Get a Joby for CA-16 Yard Sign Here!](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65a1be4b2dc001478685aecc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSc6bW5fxOa-c3K2DFfooTArcivcy1NnsMqzcIwLqMVEsFMw0A%2Fviewform&w=6514833727955b66bdb4f35b&c=b_65a150b3a862073316c12376&l=en-US&s=tMj_j-QDamOTJQ6GDYrKDVJpe-8%3D)

clean_body: The power we are building has not gone unnoticed — or unchallenged | | | Peter, With your help over the past several years, we've been able to help elect some of the most progressive members of Congress in a generation. But the power we are building together has not gone unnoticed — or unchallenged. And this year, we will face our biggest challenge yet. From now through November, our champions in Congress are going to face a barrage of attacks from the authoritarian right and their allies who want to tear down what we are building. AIPAC (the American Israel Public Affairs Committee) and the billionaire right-wing donors who fund them are reportedly planning to spend up to $100 million to unseat WFP champions in Democratic primary challenges. According to a recent filing, AIPAC has already made a record $18 million in campaign contributions in the 2023-2024 cycle — including millions to MAGA Republicans.1 Last cycle, they spent nearly $30 million to try and defeat progressives in Congress while also propping up over 100 January 6th insurrectionist Republicans.2 And over the next several months, they plan to spend as much as three times that amount or more to decimate the ranks of progressives in Congress.3 The Republican megadonors who are funding this effort know that every dollar they spend to defeat progressives in Democratic primaries also helps MAGA Republicans in their ultimate goal: to capture the White House and Congress in 2024. WFP champions in Congress have won election after election in their districts because they fight for the constituents they represent. With your support, we can help fight back against the coming deluge of attacks and preserve the progress we've fought so hard to achieve together. Thank you for standing with us as we face these challenges head-on and work towards a future where our democracy is resilient, our values are upheld, and elected officials truly serve the people. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , Sludge , January 2, 2024. 2\. , The Guardian , October 18, 2022. 3\. , The Daily Beast , November 15, 2023 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. body:
Last week, a dedicated group of 231 active duty and Veterans, myself included, sent the Declaration to the Secretary of Defense, which vows to hold accountable the military officials who illegally imposed COVID-19 shots upon hundreds of thousands of unwilling service members.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzJHaWjQvl2bgalJjlQ_NXMM-kgvGZBedX5e84lJPBOoCAZrt7uVsbmd9LbwM-OY3BA6spAxVsz3AtYarzvX_RVbK8rdNLlTsCf7ZSZX_oouDw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=congress_acknowledges_our_decl&n=1)

Dear Friend, I'm writing to share a progress update on our Declaration of Military Accountability. Last week, a dedicated group of 231 active duty and Veterans, myself included, sent the Declaration to the Secretary of Defense, which vows to hold accountable the military officials who illegally imposed COVID-19 shots upon hundreds of thousands of unwilling service members. **Yesterday, in the House of Representatives, the Subcommittee on National Security, the Border, and Foreign Affairs entered our Declaration into the Congressional Record. This is a big step forward in a short period of time. How did we do it? Your support of my campaign has given me a platform to give a voice to our active duty and Veteran service members. Thank you. Please consider chipping in today to my campaign so I can continue to fight for our military’s rank-and-file. ** **[CONTRIBUTE: Chip in to Chris To Congress 2024 »](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzJHaWjQvl2bgalJjlQ_NXMM-kgvGZBedX5e84lJPBOoCAZrt7uVsbmd9LbwM-OY3BA6spAxVsz3AtYarzvX_RVbK8rdNLlTsCf7ZSZX_oouDw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=congress_acknowledges_our_decl&n=2)
** [](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzJHaWjQvl2bgalJjlQ_NXMM-kgvGZBedX5e84lJPBOoCAZrt7uVsbmd9LbwM-OY3BA6spAxVsz3AtYarzvX_RVbK8rdNLlTsCf7ZSZX_oouDw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=congress_acknowledges_our_decl&n=3) The Declaration now has 18,000 signatures after 9 days. Many more are coming. Why? Because Americans are frustrated with the lack of accountability in our government. More and more believe that while many wrongs were committed by our government in the name of COVID, harming and violating the constitutional rights of the best of us — our volunteer Service Members — must be answered for and will not be memory-holed. While I’m proud of my role in the Declaration, I’m focused on the work in front of us. The letter and spirit of the Declaration will, ultimately, only go as far as our leaders take it. That’s why I must remind you that in just a few weeks, ballots for the March primary election will be in your mailbox. I must finish in the TOP 2 to qualify for the November general election. [**So I’m campaigning every single day up and down the North Coast. Our expenses are adding up: mailers, flyers, yard signs, digital advertisements, travel, and more. If you’re able to contribute any amount, now is the time to support our campaign! Whether you can give $5 or $500, every dollar helps bring us closer to victory in March.**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzJHaWjQvl2bgalJjlQ_NXMM-kgvGZBedX5e84lJPBOoCAZrt7uVsbmd9LbwM-OY3BA6spAxVsz3AtYarzvX_RVbK8rdNLlTsCf7ZSZX_oouDw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=congress_acknowledges_our_decl&n=4)

| Hello to my friends, family, and supporters! In 2022, we fought a tough, determined campaign for the (at the time) brand-new 6th District. Together we took in over 38% of the vote in an area that was purposefully gerrymandered for Democrats to lose. And, friends, that number turned out to be enough for them to do it again! For the third cycle in a row, we are in a different congressional district. After my congressional run, I thought long and hard about how I could best serve my community and my congressional district. This decision took some time to come to as Atlanta based GOP politicians worked to dilute my vote and decide that our voices don’t matter. That our votes don’t matter. I am here to say that our voices do matter! I am officially entering the ring and launching our campaign for Georgia’s newly drawn 7th District to show that we matter! In 2022, I was both humbled and honored to be your Democratic Nominee for the United States House of Representatives. It is my sincere hope and utmost goal to earn your trust and support for a second time. There is a lot of work to do, and I will need your help again in 2024. From updating the website to reflect the new district all the way through to putting together a team of [volunteers](https://christianforga6.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=377cebd307a6b880bd19996d8&id=7d90dac3ec&e=3d27610f3d) to begin the door-to-door canvassing to educate folks on the new boundaries for 2024 and how their vote can help. I need you to introduce me to your friends. Let me know about opportunities to speak to your civic organizations, HOAs, book clubs. [Reach out if you have a talent to share](https://christianforga6.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=377cebd307a6b880bd19996d8&id=84d2f40fdb&e=3d27610f3d). Do not worry if you don’t know what you can do to help – I’ve got a list! In addition to boots on the ground, I will need your dollars. In 2022, we fought a tough, determined campaign for the (at the time) brand-new 6th District. Together we took in over 38% of the vote in an area that was purposefully gerrymandered for Democrats to lose. And, friends, that number turned out to be enough for them to do it again! For the third cycle in a row, we are in a different congressional district. After my congressional run, I thought long and hard about how I could best serve my community and my congressional district. This decision took some time to come to as Atlanta based GOP politicians worked to dilute my vote and decide that our voices don’t matter. That our votes don’t matter. ---

**Meet Matthew Barton**
---

Matthew Barton grew up in Petal, Mississippi in a blue-collar family. His mother was a director at Tupperware and his father owned the small, family business – Barton Fence Company – where Matthew worked growing up.
After attending public school, Matthew attended Pearl River Community College and Warner University, where he studied Business Administration. He holds a law degree from Ole Miss Law, where he graduated Cum Laude and received the interviewing and counseling award.
In 2011, Matthew married his high school sweetheart, Megan. After graduating from Ole Miss Law in 2015, they moved to DeSoto County where Matthew started a law firm and Megan continued working at the Desoto County Schools as a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant.
During law school, Matthew served as an intern in the DeSoto County District Attorney’s Office where he presented cases to grand jury, tried cases to verdict, and performed all functions of a practicing attorney. He has served as a prosecutor for the City of Southaven and the City of Horn Lake and now serves as a special prosecutor for Southaven, Horn Lake, and DeSoto County Justice Courts – where he’s established a strict, tough on crime reputation.
As an attorney, Mathew has dealt with every type of criminal matter ranging from DUI to capital murder, in more than 37 courts across Mississippi.
Matthew is a member of the Federalist Society, a conservative legal association, an enhanced conceal carry permit holder, Krewe of Hernando member, NRA member, and donates his time serving as a pro bono attorney to Veterans every year.
Today, Matthew, his wife Megan, and their daughter Eleanor live in Hernando where Matthew owns his private law firm. Eleanor attends Pre-K at Hernando United Methodist Church and Megan is a stay at home mom after seven years with DeSoto County schools.

body:
Friends, the song which tells the story of my life is from a Lin-Manuel Miranda musical – and no, not the one you're thinking of!

In "Breathe" from In The Heights , a Latina sings about the responsibility she feels to make her family and community proud. Here's a sample:

"BREATHE" from In The Heights LYRICS:

"I smile at the faces I’ve known all my life
They regard me with pride
And everyone’s sweet
They say, “You’re going places"
So how can I say that, while I was away
I had so much to hide?
Hey guys, it’s me
The biggest disappointment you know
The kid couldn’t hack it
She’s back and she’s walkin’ real slow
Welcome home, just breathe

Mira, Nina
Hey
No me preocupo por ella
They’re not worried about me
Mira, allí esta nuestra estrella
They are all counting on me to succeed"

We're at a turning point in this campaign and I really do feel the weight to succeed, to prove that a Latina like me can run for Congress, overcome ALL of the obstacles, and win in order to bring better representation to our community.

But this isn't just about me. When we defeat Young Kim in November, we'll bring Democrats one step closer to ending the MAGA majority that's holding our country back.

So, friends, I want you to join me in taking a deep breath and really consider if you can spare $5, $25, or even more to give us the boost we need to start 2024 on the right foot.

Friend, It's 2024, which means it's officially our year to change this country for the better. _We're coming up on A WATERSHED moment for our campaign, and we need your help to push us toward victory._**_We are fighting to make sure the results of the Iowa Caucus shock the nation and prove the media wrong._****_Slowing down now will only put our country at risk. _**
---

We have to raise the volume on the voice of the American people--_but that means making sure they have everything they need to get to the polls._ _We need your help to raise every resource we can ahead of caucus day and we only have 72 hours left_. We're fighting for what matters, and we believe that our team will stand up and show up throughout this election cycle. STARTING RIGHT NOW: **__[_Are you going to be a part of this?_](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=cca4c33f9139376b7d8e0000973ebb9fd7e09a8be28e245921aa6bbff506d16373f18eb3eed2f4455891904a9a99cfdd94421ccacbb8bb61)__**

Team DeSantis

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=cca4c33f9139376b7d8e0000973ebb9fd7e09a8be28e245921aa6bbff506d16373f18eb3eed2f4455891904a9a99cfdd94421ccacbb8bb61)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=cca4c33f9139376b7d8e0000973ebb9fd7e09a8be28e245921aa6bbff506d16373f18eb3eed2f4455891904a9a99cfdd94421ccacbb8bb61)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

| | | **Stand With Us Against Human Trafficking in Washington's 8th******
---

Dear Peter,
Washington State is prone to human trafficking; it’s the fastest-growing criminal industry. It impacts the 8th Congressional District due to proximity to ports, international borders, vast rural areas, and dependency on agricultural workers.
Where has our current Congresswoman led on this issue? We must take a stand to stop human trafficking.
We're committed to shining a light on this dark issue and working tirelessly to eradicate human trafficking from our district. However, this battle is not one we can wage alone. In Congress, I look forward to working with federal, state, and local leaders to find solutions to end human trafficking.
Your support is crucial. Can you help with a donation of $20, $50, or even $100?

---
| | | |
---
|
Your donation will directly support:

* Strengthening legislation to target and punish traffickers.
* Raising awareness and educating our community on the signs of trafficking.
* Providing resources and support for trafficking survivors.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

| Peter,

Once again, the looming threat of a federal government shutdown is jeopardizing the livelihoods of federal workers, including those protecting our national parks, civilian shipyard employees, and the Coast Guard.

The impact of a shutdown would be felt beyond federal workers. It would hurt small business owners, government service providers, tourism, and more. Most of all, it would hurt families across the district who are already struggling with high costs.

Our region can’t afford another harmful government shutdown. And yet, the chaos and dysfunction in Congress means this is a real threat to our economy. Congress must get back to functioning and working on behalf of working folks.

It’s time to prioritize people over politics. I need you by my side in the fight to protect our federal workers and the countless families who stand to suffer in the event of a government shutdown. Friend,

Are you ready to return to the days when America was **STRONG** and **PROUD?**

Are you ready to return to leadership without the drama and without the chaos?

_**Are you ready to elect a president who can WIN and get America back on track?**_

**[I have a plan to save our country, but I need your help to spread my message before voting begins. Once you finish looking over my plan as president, I am humbly asking you to pitch in a generous donation of $5, $25, or even $47 or more today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SjRVfv7B-sBBoHZYtV28pg~~/AARclAA~ "I have a plan to save our country, but I need your help to spread my message before voting begins. Once you finish looking over my plan as president, I am humbly asking you to pitch in a generous donation of $5, $25, or even $47 or more today. ")**

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SjRVfv7B-sBBoHZYtV28pg~~/AARclAA~)
---

_**When it comes to our economy,**_ if 8% of our budget is interest, quit borrowing! Cut up the credit cards!

_**Rather than 87,000 IRS agents going after middle America,**_ let's go after the hundreds of billions of dollars of COVID fraud that we know exist.

We will stop the spending, we will stop the borrowing, we will stop the earmarks. And I will veto any spending bill that doesn't take us back to pre-COVID levels.

**When it comes to education, there should be complete transparency in the classroom.** You, as parents, should NEVER have to wonder what is being taught to your kids in schools. You have every right to know what's happening!

**We will put vocational classes back in our high schools and we will build things in America again!** In South Carolina, we put apprenticeships all over our state so that our young kids could learn how to build things. Let's put them in every single high school so that our kids are building things for America.

**When it comes to our universities, we 'll tell them: you either take Chinese money or you take American money, but the days of taking both are over.** We will get that Chinese infiltration out of our universities once and for all.

**When it comes to crime, it's simple:** Have the backs of our law enforcement and take the numbers of our criminals.

_**We will bring law and order back!**_

_**When it comes to energy independence**_ , no more going hat-in-hand to Saudi Arabia, no more getting dirty oil from Venezuela! Let's make sure we do things so that __**it 's our American producers**__ supplying __**our American families. **__

_**When it comes to our enemies, we must stop giving money to countries that hate us!**_ Quit trying to buy friends, quit paying off our enemies!

**When I am president, we will no longer give money to countries that hate America! **

We have the solutions. But I need your help to win so we can get to work and right this ship!

**[Will you please pitch in a generous donation today so we can continue to strengthen our momentum and win this? Every dollar gets us one step closer to WINNING the battle for our country's future.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SjRVfv7B-sBBoHZYtV28pg~~/AARclAA~ "Will you please pitch in a generous donation today so we can continue to strengthen our momentum and win this? Every dollar gets us one step closer to WINNING the battle for our country’s future.")**

**[Will you help me save her?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SjRVfv7B-sBBoHZYtV28pg~~/AARclAA~ "Will you help me save her? ")**

My very best,

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

This race could be the key to SAVING our Senate majority |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76985830/449005858/1237601583?sourceid=1052692&refcode=WTEFEM19_20240112_DMPDive_ND_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWMzNmI0ZS03ZmIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TeupZ9OLJA-DcktcRQ1GduHWqvfWtO7s5UfwaxIQ9eQ=) Peter, as an EMILYs List supporter, you know that the Senate majority is a BIG 2024 battleground — and this year, all eyes are on Florida. Here's why.

As a reminder, Democrats currently have a 51-49 majority in the Senate. But Democrats also currently hold **23** of the **34** Senate seats up for grabs this cycle. That means we're playing defense nationwide. But when Sen. Joe Manchin (D-WV) announced his retirement, essentially giving his seat to the Republicans, the stakes got a _lot_ higher. Now, we _have_ to pick up a seat just to _maintain_ our existing majority.

But here's the good news: experts agree that Florida is our _best shot_ to gain a Senate seat in 2024, and we've endorsed the _best_ woman for the job: **Debbie Mucarsel-Powell**. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76985831/449005859/1237601583?sourceid=1052692&refcode=WTEFEM19_20240112_DMPDive_ND_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWMzNmI0ZS03ZmIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TeupZ9OLJA-DcktcRQ1GduHWqvfWtO7s5UfwaxIQ9eQ=) Former U.S. Rep. **Debbie Mucarsel-Powell** is the perfect challenger in the race for Sen. Rick Scott's Florida seat for a few reasons:
1. **Sen. Scott has never won an election by more than 1.2% of the vote.**__ As a first-term incumbent, this makes him vulnerable. And in contrast, Debbie won her Republican-leaning Congressional district by _1.8%_ in 2018.
2. **Scott has never run in a presidential election year.** And in Florida, Republicans typically perform _worse_ in presidential election years than they do during midterm elections.
3. **More than 60% of Floridians want to enshrine abortion access in their state constitution.** In spite of this, Scott has said he would __ proudly vote __ to pass a _national abortion ban._ Debbie is the pro-choice champion Floridians need to uphold their values in the Senate.

As a former member of Congress, Debbie has a history of public service and advocacy on behalf of Floridians — and she's ready to bring her passion and experience to the Senate. Control of the Senate could _easily_ come down to Florida this November, and Debbie will need the _full support_ of this community to flip this vulnerable seat. ****Democratic pro-choice women saved our Senate majority in 2022,_and they can do it again this year._ Donate now to help support fierce pro-choice Senate candidates like Debbie in must-win races across the country:**** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $15](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76985832/449005860/1237601583?expresslane=true&amount=15&sourceid=1052692&refcode=WTEFEM19_20240112_DMPDive_ND_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWMzNmI0ZS03ZmIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TeupZ9OLJA-DcktcRQ1GduHWqvfWtO7s5UfwaxIQ9eQ=) | [DONATE $35](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76985833/449005861/1237601583?expresslane=true&amount=35&sourceid=1052692&refcode=WTEFEM19_20240112_DMPDive_ND_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWMzNmI0ZS03ZmIxLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TeupZ9OLJA-DcktcRQ1GduHWqvfWtO7s5UfwaxIQ9eQ=)

clean_body: This race could be the key to SAVING our Senate majority | = Peter, as an EMILYs List supporter, you know that the Senate majority is a BIG 2024 battleground — and this year, all eyes are on Florida. Here's why. As a reminder, Democrats currently have a 51-49 majority in the Senate. But Democrats also currently hold 23 of the 34 Senate seats up for grabs this cycle. That means we're playing defense nationwide. But when Sen. Joe Manchin (D-WV) announced his retirement, essentially giving his seat to the Republicans, the stakes got a lot higher. Now, we have to pick up a seat just to maintain our existing majority. But here's the good news: experts agree that Florida is our best shot to gain a Senate seat in 2024, and we've endorsed the best woman for the job: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. = Former U.S. Rep. Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is the perfect challenger in the race for Sen. Rick Scott's Florida seat for a few reasons: 1. Sen. Scott has never won an election by more than 1.2% of the vote. As a first-term incumbent, this makes him vulnerable. And in contrast, Debbie won her Republican-leaning Congressional district by 1.8% in 2018. 2. Scott has never run in a presidential election year. And in Florida, Republicans typically perform worse in presidential election years than they do during midterm elections. 3. More than 60% of Floridians want to enshrine abortion access in their state constitution. In spite of this, Scott has said he would proudly vote to pass a national abortion ban. Debbie is the pro-choice champion Floridians need to uphold their values in the Senate. As a former member of Congress, Debbie has a history of public service and advocacy on behalf of Floridians — and she's ready to bring her passion and experience to the Senate. Control of the Senate could easily come down to Florida this November, and Debbie will need the full support of this community to flip this vulnerable seat. **Democratic pro-choice women saved our Senate majority in 2022,and they can do it again this year. Hi team, it’s Jason.

I’m not asking for money today. I just wanted to say thank you.

Earlier this week, I announced my reelection campaign for Congress. I don’t like people fighting my battles for me — and with so many important fights happening in Congress, I’m not ready to give up yet.

Since then, folks in your area and across the country have poured in to support our campaign. The feedback we’re receiving is incredible, and I couldn’t be more excited for what’s ahead.

I’m running for Congress because business-as-usual isn’t cutting it. We need leaders who share our life experiences and can deliver for our families.

As someone who comes from a working-class family, I know what the struggle is like. I worked construction to help put myself through college — digging foundations from sunrise to sunset. I know what it’s like to put in a hard day’s work and still struggle to make ends meet.

There’s still more we need to do to level the playing field for hardworking Coloradans. I’m ready to continue being your advocate in Congress.

One of the most important things to me is hearing your thoughts. Will you help shape our campaign strategy by taking our first-ever 2024 Campaign Priorities Survey today? [https://act.jasoncrowforcongress.com/a/2024-01-survey]

BEGIN THE SURVEY » [https://act.jasoncrowforcongress.com/a/2024-01-survey]

Whether you’ve been with this campaign for the past 5 years or 5 days, thank you. Onward to November!

— Jason Crow

Now more than ever, we need strong leaders like Jason working for us in Congress. Jason is fighting for you, your family, and the American people in Congress — and he's not taking a dime of corporate PAC money. Will you pitch in now to help him continue working for us?

| | **For immediate release:** January 12, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**ICYMI: Bill to End Offshore Oil Drilling in CA Waters Passes First Major Legislative Hurdle**
_By Dan Bacher for Daily Kos_
SACRAMENTO, CA — New oil leases for offshore oil and gas drilling have been banned in California waters for decades, but the oil industry can keep drilling in state waters 3 miles and less from shore under existing leases.

Senator Dave Min’s Senate Bill (SB) 559 seeks to change this situation by requiring the California State Lands Commission to take immediate steps to terminate the remaining leases for offshore oil drilling in California state waters.

The bill passed out of its first legislative committee earlier this week. The State Senate Natural Resources and Water Committee, chaired by Senator Min, approved the measure by a 7-3 vote. “As the 2021 oil spill off the coast of Orange County starkly illustrated (as did the 2015 Refugio Beach oil spill), offshore drilling poses a clear and immediate threat to our beautiful beaches and our vibrant $44 billion a year coastal economy,” said Senator Min**.**

“These offshore oil rigs, which were built between the 1960s and 1980s, are long past their shelf life, and the wildcat oil companies that now operate these rigs have no incentives to invest meaningfully in their safety and soundness. We simply cannot afford to have more oil spills, and SB 559 provides an immediate pathway towards shutting these offshore oil platforms down. Thank you to my colleagues in the Senate Natural Resources and Water Committee for their support of SB 559,” he argued.

The Center for Biological Diversity and other environmental groups are supporting the legislation. "This bill is critical to warding off more devastating spills from the oil industry's decrepit, corroding infrastructure,” said Brady Bradshaw, oceans campaigner at the Center for Biological Diversity.“Offshore drilling is a public nuisance that’s already done horrific damage to our beautiful coastline, wildlife and the vital coastal economy. We have to ensure that companies pay promptly to clean up their own pollution rather than dumping their toxic messes on Californians.”

Senator Min said he first introduced a version of this bill in 2022, but it was held in the Senate Committee on Appropriations. He reintroduced the bill last year, and held it while the Lands Commission worked on its study of the potential costs of shutting down and decommissioning these platforms.

“With an update of that study now in hand, SB 559 would require the State Lands Commission to finalize negotiations for voluntary relinquishment of oil and gas leases. If an agreement is not made by December 31, 2026, the bill requires the Commission to terminate the leases and pay fair compensation if warranted,” according to Min.

California has three remaining oil platforms in operation off the Coast of Orange County: Eva, Emmy, and Ester. All three platforms were constructed between 1963 and 1985, and have lasted decades beyond their intended lifespans.

As of October 1, 2021, there were a total of 150 reported permits issued by CalGEM, California’s oil and gas regulation, in offshore wells in state waters under existing leases since January 1, 2019, according to an analysis posted at [**www.NewsomWellWatch.org**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3bd7763f49&e=7017cc100e) by Consumer Watchdog and FracTracker Alliance. Five of these permits were for new drilling and the remaining 145 for reworks (including sidetracks and deepening operations).

Peter, it’s been one month since Kate Cox was forced to flee Texas to seek the life saving treatment she needed after she was denied an abortion recommended by her doctor during a nonviable pregnancy. And Kat Cox isn’t alone. More Texas women have been denied life saving healthcare, and the Supreme Court announced they will decide whether emergency room doctors can perform medically necessary abortions. In TX-15, Monica De La Cruz _still_ remains silent on the state banning women from making their own decisions about their bodies. **Monica De La Cruz’s silence is dangerous.** Texas women now have to flee the state to access the lifesaving treatment they need. That’s because anti-abortion Republican extremists like Monica have embraced a complete abortion ban allowing politicians to make private health care decisions that should only belong to a woman and her doctor. **Monica De La Cruz thinks she knows better than your doctor. clean_body: Texas women are being forced to flee the state — and Monica has nothing to say about it. | | | Peter, it’s been one month since Kate Cox was forced to flee Texas to seek the life saving treatment she needed after she was denied an abortion recommended by her doctor during a nonviable pregnancy. And Kat Cox isn’t alone. More Texas women have been denied life saving healthcare, and the Supreme Court announced they will decide whether emergency room doctors can perform medically necessary abortions. In TX-15, Monica De La Cruz still remains silent on the state banning women from making their own decisions about their bodies. Monica De La Cruz’s silence is dangerous. Texas women now have to flee the state to access the lifesaving treatment they need. That’s because anti-abortion Republican extremists like Monica have embraced a complete abortion ban allowing politicians to make private health care decisions that should only belong to a woman and her doctor. Monica De La Cruz thinks she knows better than your doctor. In Congress, I’ll fight to end this extreme ban and give Texas women their freedom back. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Our country and our world are in a pivotal, historic moment right now.

Over the last two days, the country of South Africa — whose people
survived through decades of apartheid — made their case against Israel for
violating the Genocide Convention in the International Court of Justice at
The Hague. South Africa presented detailed, damning evidence of Israel
intentionally conducting genocide against Palestinians, and is seeking to
hold them accountable and end the killing with a permanent ceasefire.

Unsurprisingly, the Biden Administration claims this case is meritless,
while it continues to unconditionally support and fund the Israeli
military’s all-out assault on innocent Palestinian civilians and further
escalate conflict in the Middle East.

Last night, the U.S. conducted military strikes in Yemen without any
Congressional authorization. A dangerous, unilateral decision by President
Biden that completely disregards our Constitution. Every member of
Congress should find these actions to be unacceptable.

We cannot allow our government to skirt responsibility for its
contributions to this genocide and throw us into yet another endless war
in the Middle East. The White House and Congress must act immediately and
refuse to send even one more dollar to the Israeli military and work
towards brokering an immediate and permanent ceasefire.

Justice Democrats incumbents like Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, and Summer Lee
were among the first to condemn the Biden Administration’s escalation in
Yemen, and continue to lead the call for an immediate, permanent ceasefire
in Gaza. But we could risk losing their pro-peace voices in Congress this
year as they face tough re-election fights and a $100 million threat from
the Israel lobby.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240112.W-In26&refcode=em20240112-32795&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32795%2E1203867%2Ey9crBy ]If you can, please help us strengthen the movement for peace and human
rights here and abroad by fueling Justice Democrats’ work to protect the
Squad from right-wing, pro-war opponents like AIPAC in this year’s
critical elections →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240112.W-In26&refcode=em20240112-32795&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1020&akid=32795%2E1203867%2Ey9crBy ]Contribute $3

Now is the time for us to come together and show that the American people
have no interest in their government enabling the genocide of the
Palestinian people or waging another endless war in the Middle East in
their name, paid for by our taxpayer dollars.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a

using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1022&akid=32795%2E1203867%2Ey9crBy ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

| | | | The National Debt is a wake-up call | [](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-21-38-29-8f3279df2b-5hc256ce21)
---
**Dear Fellow Patriot,**

The Treasury Department's recent announcement that the United States national debt has reached a staggering $34 trillion is a wake-up call for all of us.

_This astronomical figure, equivalent to the combined economies of China, Germany, Japan, India, and the U.K., underscores the critical situation we face_.

**In just three months, the debt has increased by $1 trillion**.

To put this into a relatable context, imagine every American household contributing $1,000 monthly; it would still take 22 years to pay down the national debt – and that's without it rising further. This situation should alarm every citizen.

Despite these alarming figures, the Biden administration and many in Congress continue to turn a blind eye.

The decision last May to raise the debt limit without addressing the root causes of our fiscal issues – unchecked government spending – has led us to where we are today: experiencing high inflation and a struggling economy.

**As your representative, I voted against raising the debt limit because I understood the consequences of ignoring our spending problem.**

Our families and small businesses are bearing the brunt of these misguided policies.

Congress must take decisive action to address these fiscal imbalances. This means drastically reducing unnecessary and wasteful spending and implementing policies that stimulate economic growth while tackling our out-of-control debt.

Last year, there were numerous opportunities to curb spending. For instance, I supported an amendment proposing a modest 1% cut in spending. Yet, this sensible proposal was defeated, with many Republicans joining Democrats in opposition. The refusal to make even a minimal spending cut signals a worrying inability to address our debt crisis.

**Moreover, the willingness of these same lawmakers to allocate billions of dollars to foreign ventures, like in Ukraine, while neglecting our domestic fiscal responsibilities, is unacceptable**. Frankly, this necessitates a significant change in our congressional representation. We need a new cadre of Republicans committed to fiscal responsibility and the well-being of our nation.

**[I urge you to join me in this critical fight. Our nation's future and the prosperity of our citizens depend on it](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-21-38-29-8f3279df2b-5hc256ce21).

[Together, we can work towards a more fiscally responsible government that prioritizes the needs of the American people](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-21-38-29-8f3279df2b-5hc256ce21)**.

Thank you for your support and commitment to our shared values.

**For Freedom,**

Congressman Paul A. Gosar, D.D.S. | [ DONATE >> ](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-21-38-29-8f3279df2b-5hc256ce21)

clean_body: We need allies not just in Congress, but in state houses across the country. | | | Friend, A majority of Americans, including 80% of Democrats, support a ceasefire. Yet the Biden administration continues to send bombs to the Israeli military in its campaign to wipe out the Palestinian people. As U.S. officials contribute to dehumanization that’s hurting not just Palestinians in Gaza, but also Arab and Muslim Americans, we need allies in the federal government and in state houses across the country. Illinois State Representative Abdelnasser Rashid is the first Palestinian American to serve in the Illinois legislature. And he’s facing attacks by his Democratic primary opponent for demanding a ceasefire now. Last summer, while visiting family in the West Bank, Abdelnasser watched as, in his words, “a group of armed Israeli settlers invaded the village, torched an entire neighborhood, shot a bunch of people, killed a young man. All with the support of the Israel Defense Forces and the Israeli government that looked the other way even though these attacks had been advertised ahead of time.” Rep. Rashid is a leader for human rights and we need him in office. He needs our support now to win his March Democratic primary. | Abdelnasser is running for re-election in the midst of a rise in anti-Arab, Muslim, and Palestinian attacks in the United States and across the globe. In October, 6-year-old Wadea Al-Fayoume was murdered in an anti-Palestinian hate crime in Abdelnasser’s community. Abdelnassar attended Wadea’s funeral, noting that “the politicians and many in the media cheering on Israel's march toward genocide [has] created an environment of hate right here in America” that “directly led to this brutal murder.” Abdelnasser is demanding that President Biden and members of Congress stop contributing to this hate, and instead recognize the humanity of Palestinians and join the vast majority of Americans in demanding an immediate and permanent ceasefire. Rep. body:
Our fundraising hasn’t just fallen off this month. It has ground to a complete stop.
#

Peter, we’re in trouble.
Our fundraising hasn’t just fallen off this month. It has ground to a complete stop.
We can’t tell why — if it’s because folks are waiting for Kyrsten Sinema to decide whether she’s running or not...
Or if it’s because Ruben’s led in a few polls here and there...
Or if it’s because people think Kari Lake is too extreme to win, and we’ve got this locked up.
**Whatever it is, this race is most certainly not locked up. Not yet.**
Yes, we’ve led in a few polls... _but we’re also behind in a few._
We can’t just wait around until Sinema makes her decision... _because if she gets in this race and we’re not ready, Kari Lake could get the edge on us._
**So here’s a reality check:** Our majority in the Senate is on a razor’s edge. Kari Lake only lost her last election in Arizona by less than a percent of the vote. Back in 2016, when all of us thought that race was locked up, we ended up with President Donald Trump. And that guy... he’s surging in the polls right now.
We’ve got to get back on track. If we don’t, it could be an absolute disaster. For us, for our chances at holding the Senate, and for the country at large.

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g7epQaNwzMS7ffgdA1cyDg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnhE2oP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci9kZDMwZDdhMS0yOTI1LTRmZGEtOWY1Zi1hNWExZjA0OTg1NTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTEyX0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgplnmehoWUL3LCRUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g7epQaNwzMS7ffgdA1cyDg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnhE2oP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci9kZDMwZDdhMS0yOTI1LTRmZGEtOWY1Zi1hNWExZjA0OTg1NTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTEyX0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgplnmehoWUL3LCRUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

body:
[1]Powered By People

A man inspired by Donald Trump’s demonization of migrants slaughtered 23
people in El Paso, claiming that he was repelling “the Hispanic invasion
of Texas.”

On the eve of that killing, a man also inspired by Trump’s demonization of
migrants, Texas Governor Greg Abbott, [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60805?source=ema20240112-237789&t=1001&akid=237789%2E444211%2E3qXur3 ]sent a letter to his supporters
and suggested that when it comes to immigration, it’s time to “take
matters into our own hands” and to “defend Texas” against the invasion
that Trump had incessantly warned the country about.

That was almost four years ago.

This week, Abbott said that he’d give the order to kill migrants if he
could.

In response to an interviewer’s question about his commitment to
addressing the number of migrants coming to America at the Texas border,
he said:

“We are using every tool that can be used, from building a border wall
to building these border barriers, to passing this law that I signed
that led to another lawsuit by the Biden administration, where I signed
a law making it illegal for somebody to enter Texas from another
country. And they're subject to arrest and subject to deportation. So,
we are deploying every tool and strategy that we possibly can. The only
thing that we're not doing is we're not shooting people who come across
the border, because of course, the Biden administration would charge us
with murder.”

It might be hard to believe, so [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60806?s=20%3Fsource%3Dema20240112-237789&t=1002&akid=237789%2E444211%2E3qXur3 ]here’s a link to the audio of the
governor of the state of Texas saying he’d kill migrants and asylum
seekers if it weren’t for the fact that he’d be charged with murder.

And the border barriers that he mentions in that same response? Those are
things like a [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60807?source=ema20240112-237789&t=1003&akid=237789%2E444211%2E3qXur3 ]giant drowning device that he anchored in the middle of
the Rio Grande river channel, increasing the likelihood of more migrant
drownings (in a year that has seen [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60808?source=ema20240112-237789&t=1004&akid=237789%2E444211%2E3qXur3 ]a new record in the number of
migrant deaths). Things like razor wire that he deployed underneath the
waters of the river, [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60809?source=ema20240112-237789&t=1005&akid=237789%2E444211%2E3qXur3 ]ensnaring children and pregnant mothers.

This governor has presided over a level of cruelty and death that is

name: Liam Bradigan
subject: It's Petition Time
body:
__
Friends,____
____
It’s almost that time of year – time to circulate petitions to get Blake on the ballot! This is a crucial step in our campaign in order to ensure that we get Blake to Congress to help restore trust in government among residents of the Central Pennsylvania region.____
____
Blake needs a minimum of**1,000 signatures** in order to get on the ballot – but our goal is to get many more than that from all three counties in our district – Cumberland, Dauphin and York – in order to show the broad and deep grassroots support Blake has throughout the 10th Congressional District.____
____
But we cannot do it without you!_We can circulate petitions from**January 23** through **February 13** , and need all hands on deck during that time in order to reach our goal._______
____
If you are interested in circulating a petition,**please respond to this email** so we can make arrangements to get you the materials you need. Materials will also be available for download at [blakelynch.com/volunteers](http://blakelynch.com/volunteers).____
____
Finally, if you have never circulated a petition or have questions, there are two opportunities for trainings, one in-person training hosted by Dauphin County Dems and one virtual Zoom training hosted by the York County Dems, that you can join briefly to ensure you have the information you need to get started:____
____
* Dauphin County (in-person training)- Tuesday, January 16 from 6:00 PM-7:30 PM at the AFSCME Conference Center (150 S 43rd Street, Harrisburg, PA 17111)
* York County- Tuesday, January 16 from 7:00 PM-8:30 PM (virtual training) [2024 Petitioning Master Class · Mobilize](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/595975/)

Blake is the candidate in this race that is from Central Pennsylvania and for Central Pennsylvania. The hardworking residents of this region deserve a leader who not only understands their needs and struggles – but will fight for them in Congress every day and ensure their voices are heard. That is why we need to step up now to fight for HIM to get on the ballot.____
____
We need you! Sign up to help us today!____
____
If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me, Liam Bradigan, at this email, or at my cell 717-903-7707.____
____
Best,____
__Liam
Volunteer Coordinator at Blake Lynch for Congress

__Send Blake to Congress![Donate Now!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-blake-lynch)

| Let me take a moment to explain why expanding Metro light rail across Southern California is emblematic of the public service I try to embody every single day.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=5043%2E5257348%2EIeYhZC)
Derek,
One of my proudest accomplishments as a State Senator was establishing the Gold Line Light.
**I’ve worked for years to support public transit in California, and the many amazing transit workers who keep it running. And I’m proud to have been endorsed by the Amalgamated Transit Union.**
[DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240112_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=5043%2E5257348%2EIeYhZC)
---
I know it might sound a bit unusual that light rail is one of the most exciting things I’ve worked on.
But let me take a moment to explain why expanding Metro light rail across Southern California is emblematic of the public service I try to embody every single day, whether as a State Senator, a member of Congress, or hopefully as a U.S. Senator.
-> It helps the environment! Light Rail reduces carbon emissions, decreases air pollution, _and_ eases traffic congestion, something we have plenty of in California.
-> It’s about working together: During my time in the State Senate, I worked with both Democrats _and_ Republicans to get this legislation across the finish line.
-> It’s about listening to voters and constituents to hear what will _actually_ make a difference: I spoke to people in my district who were desperately hoping for an alternative way to get across town. I listened and got to work to find a solution.
-> It’s about fixing what’s broken and setting up for future successes: At the time I passed the Gold Line Light Rail Authority, the Metro line was dying from cost overruns. I worked to identify the issues with the service, wrote legislation to fix it, and ultimately created a model for what other mass transit projects in California would look like.
**The Metro Gold Line, now a part of the A and E Lines, thanks to more exciting rail expansions continues to serve millions of people daily, and I’m honored to have the title, “Father of the Gold Line.”**
**[Derek, as California’s next U.S. Senator, I will always look for opportunities to make a real difference in people’s lives. I’ll listen to voters, work with broad coalitions, and take on the tough fights. If you support this work, please chip in $3 to my campaign for Senate today.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240112_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=5&akid=5043%2E5257348%2EIeYhZC)**

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.
